The Chester Chesterfield Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a deep-button tufted headboard in the Chester style, handmade to order in Dewsbury on a wooden slatted base.

Key features

  • Deep-button tufted Chester-style headboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £350.99; Double (4FT6) £363.99; King (5FT) £389.99; Super King (6FT) £415.99. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes; custom fabric and colour options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What sizes does the Chester Chesterfield Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I choose a different colour or fabric?

Yes. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, and custom fabric and colour requests are welcome.

Where is the Chester Chesterfield Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check the colour and texture at home before ordering.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse all Chesterfield beds or read the Chesterfield bed buying guide.

Looking for a kids bed with a bit of grown-up style? The Chester Kids Bed is a handmade upholstered children's bed with a deep-buttoned Chester-style panel headboard and a robust low frame. It is made to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire, from £311.99 in Kids Single 2.6ft to £376.99 in Small Double 4ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Deep-buttoned Chester-style headboard
  • Low frame construction
  • Soft, durable upholstered fabric
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

  • Kids Single 2.6ft: £311.99
  • Single 3ft: £337.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £376.99

Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches the mattress you plan to use. Our 1000 Pocket Sprung Mattress and the rest of our mattresses come in the same sizes.

Customisation

Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches let you check the colour at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

More ideas: browse all kids beds, compare the Mayfair Kids Bed or Line Kids Velvet Bed, or read our kids upholstered beds guide.

FAQ

What sizes does the Chester Kids Bed come in?

Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft.

Is it a low bed?

Yes, it has a robust low frame with a deep-buttoned padded headboard.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check the colour and feel at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

The Chesterfield Kids Bed brings the classic Chesterfield look to a child's bedroom, scaled down: deep button tufting on a curved, fully padded frame with a matching footboard and no sharp edges.

Key features

  • Deep button-tufted Chesterfield-style headboard
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Rounded design with no sharp edges
  • Solid, sturdy wood frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. One price applies to all three sizes. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered with rounded edges. Available in colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is it a real Chesterfield style?

Yes, it has deep button tufting in the Chesterfield style, scaled for a child's bed.

What sizes does the Chesterfield Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

Does the bed have sharp edges?

No. It is fully upholstered with enclosed side panels and a rounded design, with no sharp edges.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3-5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.
